title: Learning trumpet, switching to saxophone and clarinet, the revival concert
summary: Mason recalls his Scotch teacher, losing his improvising, teeth trouble, learning to play by ear in Camden, and returning to clarinet for a St. Louis concert with Ralph Sutton.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings
